name: marliechorgan-skills
description: Free Claude skills and safety guards: sub-agents, agent apps, careful coding, browser automation, open-source contributions, human-sounding writing, and hooks that stop an agent doing damage.

plugins.name: working-skills
plugins.description: Ten skills and a browser agent for doing real work with Claude: brief sub-agents, run several in parallel, design and test agent apps, drive a browser and sign in safely, write and review code without silent failures, wrap up cleanly, contribute to open source, and write messages that sound like you.

plugins.name: safety
plugins.description: Guards for Claude Code that block destructive commands, edits to the agent's own settings and secrets, data leaving your machine, destructive git, network-exposed dev servers and hidden instructions in web content. Includes a test kit and a macOS managed-settings installer.
